newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India gains after budget approved.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India gains after budget approved.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts ended firmer after India's parliament approved the 1997/1998 budget, traders said.
They said approval of the budget, which slashes taxes and tariffs, has given confidence to foreign investors.
"The overall mood is positive, though in the short term we will be in a trading range," a trader said.
Traders said that uncertainty over a corruption scandal involving Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's Janata Dal party chief will serve as a cap on the market next week.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed 1.45 points up at 79.91, with the premium over the local market at 22.32 percent from 20.06 percent.
Hindalco added $1.13 to $32.00/$33.00 and Reliance added 72 cents to $19.12/$20.12.

Taiwanese GDRs tracked local stocks lower on jitters following the resignations of three cabinet ministers ahead of a planned cabinet reshuffle, with the Capel Taiwan GDR Index down 1.17 points, or 0.95 percent, to 122.59, representing a discount to the local market of 3.14 percent.
The Capel Korea GDR Index added 1.31 points to 62.12 points, a premium of 36.24 percent over the local market.
